prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A practical Roblox 3D game art sheet showing the ACTUAL INTERIOR of a tiny starter shack, made from chunky low-poly flat-colour SmoothPlastic blocks, no realistic textures. One room 16 by 12 studs inside an 18 by 14 stud shack. The interior is physically inside the exterior, with the front wall cut away ONLY for this drawing. Clear real front doorway at ground level, no portal and no teleport room. Main cutaway perspective plus small matching top-down plan. DINGY BUT CHARMING: faded beige walls, a few uneven cocoa flat-colour boards, one crooked shelf with two small earned trophies, tiny achievement notebook on a small crate, slightly mismatched repairs shown as solid flat panels, one weak warm lamp, a small blue window. Modest empty floor for Roblox avatars to walk; no sofa, huge bookcase or grand pedestal. Simple code-buildable geometry. Show a tiny section of exterior sloping roof to establish that the real room fits inside the shack. Bright readable daylight, not dark horror. Off-white background, heading only 'STARTER SHACK · WALK-IN INTERIOR'. No floating magical symbols, no architecture outside its footprint. This is an honest tiny first home, visibly poorer than a palace.

Use case: stylized-concept. Practical low-poly Roblox architectural game art sheet, chunky SmoothPlastic flat colours with no photoreal textures. Show a physically ENTERABLE compact manor house with TWO ACCESSIBLE FLOORS connected by one real L-shaped staircase and a safe landing. Cut away front wall and parts of roof purely for this drawing, so both floors are visible together; no teleport, no separate room floating outside. Footprint 36 by 28 studs, two levels each 11 studs clear height. Ground floor welcoming entry with centred real doorway, small achievement wall and career record board; stair occupies back-left corner. Upstairs a trophy gallery with 3 compact wall display bays, a featured trophy pedestal near the rear wall, a plain Legacy plaque. Hallway remains clear around the stair opening, solid floor between storeys with railing on landing. Warm cream walls, dark brown trim, deep plum roof, small warm brass details. All furniture sturdy and simple, a few gold trophies as placeholders only. Main three-quarter dollhouse cutaway left, two matching small floorplan diagrams stacked right. Label only 'MANOR · TWO WALKABLE FLOORS', 'GROUND FLOOR', 'UPPER FLOOR'. Exact doors, stairs and openings must align between cutaway and plans. Limit detail so this could be built from about 150-200 simple game parts plus existing trophies. Exterior and interior are one coherent building.
